The water runs downhill from D, always in the direction of steepest descent, so its path crosses every contour line at a right angle. 6 campsites are marked with magenta points, C1 to C6, all lower than the dam. Exactly one of them lies in the water's path. Which campsite does the water reach? Answer with the campsite name, for example C2.

The dam D stands at about 326 m. From D the steepest way down sets off heading about 136 degrees (southeast), crossing each contour line at a right angle. FINAL ANSWER: C2
